newsitem.title: CANADA: Precision Drilling proposes stock split.
newsitem.headline: Precision Drilling proposes stock split.

text.p: Precision Drilling Corp said on Friday it would propose a two-for-one stock split at its annual meeting in September.
Precision, whose shares in Toronto surged this year to a 52-week high of 77.30 from a low of 29.55, said its planned record date for the split was September 30.
The annual meeting is scheduled for Calgary on September 18.
Precision shares were up 1.50 to 71 in early Friday trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange. In New York, Precision, Canada's biggest oil and gas drilling company, jumped 1-1/8 to 51-1/8.
